coordinate_system: Y-up, -Z forward; one exported unit is one meter

asset_contract.title: Helm
asset_contract.summary: An airship helm console: a wooden plinth and banded iron column carrying a brass gearbox with a 1.1 m spoked wheel on its aft face, a brass cup and equator ring on the gearbox holding the navigation compass behind the wheel, and two levers on brass quadrants (throttle starboard, pitch port). Core part core.helm; the HelmStation fixture.
asset_contract.placement: Pivot at the centre of the deck under the column. The helmsman stands aft (-Z) facing the bow (+Z); the Seat is at (0, 1.05, -1.2). Height 1.74 m (the wheel's top handle), under the crew body's 1.85 m eye line.

nodes.name: Helm_Stand
nodes.role: Static: plinth, column, gearbox and axle, the compass mount on the gearbox (stalk, cup and a ring round the glass's equator; the compass glass, 0.30 m across, centred at (0, 1.55, 0.05), NavigationConfig.CompassLocalPosition), both lever brackets and quadrant plates.

nodes.name: Helm_Wheel
nodes.role: Moving part (yaw). Pivot on its hub at (0, 1.15, -0.33); turns about local Z. 1.1 m across the handles.

nodes.name: Helm_ThrottleLever
nodes.role: Moving part (throttle). Pivot on its axle at (0.42, 0.86, -0.05), starboard; swings about local X, upright at rest.

nodes.name: Helm_PitchLever
nodes.role: Moving part (pitch). Pivot on its axle at (-0.42, 0.86, -0.05), port; swings about local X, upright at rest.

asset_contract.materials: Helm_Wood, Helm_Brass, Helm_Iron, Helm_Paint; HelmAssetBuilder swaps each for the shared ship material (M_ShipHull, M_ShipEngine, M_ShipIron, M_ShipPennant).
asset_contract.footprint_blocks: Fits one block; the part keeps its 3 x 2 x 5 footprint so the designs and the helm scenarios hold.
asset_contract.collision: One box round the console and the compass on the prefab (1.2 x 1.75 x 0.75 m): what Interact hits and what blocks walking. No mesh collider.
asset_contract.movable_parts: All three are static for now; drive them from the helmsman's station axes (x throttle, y yaw, z pitch) for steering motion.
